from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Horizontal separator.
    rows = [r for r in range(1, h - 1) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]
    if rows and (len(set(g[0])) > 1 or g[0][0] == g[0][1]):
        s = rows[0]
        top = next(r for r in range(s - 1, -1, -1) if len(set(g[r])) > 1)
        bottom = next(r for r in range(s + 1, h) if len(set(g[r])) > 1)
        bg = Counter(g[top]).most_common(1)[0][0]
        counts = Counter(g[bottom])
        for c in range(w):
            a, b = g[top][c], g[bottom][c]
            if a != bg:
                g[top][c] = bg
                g[s - 1 if a == b else 0][c] = a
                if a == b and counts[b] > 2:
                    g[bottom][c] = Counter(g[bottom]).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return g
    # Vertical separator; patterns lie immediately on either side.
    s = next(c for c in range(1, w - 1) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != g[0][0])
    left = next(c for c in range(s) if any(g[r][c] != g[r][0] for r in range(h)))
    right = s + 1
    bg = g[0][0]
    adjacent = left == s - 1
    for r in range(h):
        a, b = g[r][left], g[r][right]
        if adjacent:
            if a != b and b != g[r][right + 1]:
                g[r][right] = g[r][right + 1]
                g[r][w - 1] = b
        elif a != bg:
            g[r][left] = bg
            g[r][s - 2 if a == b else 0] = a
    return g
